result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from every listing and lookup you named. The full test suite passes offline (`mvn -q -o test`). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added `String description` as the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`schema.sql`**: added a nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column to `promotion`.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and `promotionRow` reads it. Every promotion SELECT now includes the column: by code, active on a date, active in a region, by category, best for a category on a date, and unused in a period.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are treated. The existing 5-argument method is unchanged and delegates with no description, so existing callers and demo data still work.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `returnsDescriptionWithPromotion` test. It creates SUMMER with the description and a second promotion without one, then checks the text through all six listings and lookups.

The `usage` listing returns `PromotionUsage`, not `Promotion`, so it has no description and I left it alone.
